question: Why must revilers of Shiva and the Kula Bhairava be denied this instruction?
premises: Slandering the Kula Bhairava is disqualifying
The goddess is addressed regarding this prohibition
inference: The teaching must not be given to one who reviles Shiva or slanders the Kula Bhairava.
uncertainties: kulabhairave may qualify nindake or stand as a separate category
plain_english: O Goddess, not to one who reviles Shiva, nor to a slanderer of the Kula Bhairava.
